name: Instant Connect WeChat for WooCommerce
author: Tensor Ray

sections.description:
Instant Connect WeChat for WooCommerce allows you to send WooCommerce order notifications directly to your WeCom (WeChat Work) contacts.

The plugin utilizes WeCom’s ability to add customers’ personal WeChat accounts as external contacts. By sending notifications to a group chat, you can reach your customers directly on their personal WeChat, greatly boosting delivery rates and improving customer experience.

Other resources

  • “Post Flow“, which helps you schedule your website’s content for automatic publishing.
  • “Linked Media Without Import“, allows you to use images from external URLs in your media library without actually downloading them to your server.
  • I have also written a beginner’s guide, “A Tutorial on Developing WordPress Plugins with React“, to help you get started with plugin development.

Get in Touch

If you have specific needs for a WordPress theme or plugin, feel free to contact me. I will collect user requests and may develop new themes or plugins to address common problems and needs.
